<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>FCRA Amendment:</strong> A 31-member Joint Parliamentary Committee, chaired by BJP’s Sanjay Jaiswal, has been constituted to examine the FCRA Amendment Bill 2026.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNQldEamNzSDhyVExJZ01MdXlmZGdFQ3NiaDlOWXBoZGozQmZvalJVbEZFbC1HRldWUWRhYnJFaTN3T0Z4WmtpNV9BNDZ6UFFQaWU2Z3hJNG45R3NhdkpHdnZ4SElTSlZrLS16NzIwYWtBMjcwMzhhZXl2NDFfOGFvTW15VjZqTzlYNGdNYzlWQ0V1ekliTHhYaUNKYkZzYmVwbGpaUUVYMEoyQWlicGtZNThfN2tDVHIz?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Telangana Cabinet Reshuffle:</strong> Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has dismissed Konda Surekha from the state cabinet, a move defended by party leadership as necessary to address damaging internal conduct.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary Disqualification:</strong> The Lok Sabha Speaker has granted 20 rebel TMC MPs, including Sudip Bandyopadhyay, until September 22 to respond to disqualification notices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral Roll Disputes:</strong> BJP Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha has alleged political vendetta after his name was deleted from Punjab’s draft electoral rolls, though experts maintain his parliamentary seat remains secure.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Alliance Realignment:</strong> The Congress party has formally ended its political alliance with the Raijor Dal in Assam, citing repeated violations of alliance ethics and misconduct.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxPVkpZRmhHM0JXUXJrVkJBb2wxaXVpSE1td1hBOVRydzFYajl2X0hoZV9SLUtyM2N2UkozdWx0cWlDbDIwaUF4SWNkYU9iT0lIdWNPTG5rTXp4VzRaQXVUUnhwRDFzREFVUVNTa05TMTV0eENzYzdoQ2hFOFJESkFSdjNRMnlmNUZNcHpDRXhWalhCZEh5dUNLQllZOFF3ZjBMeG5SNVlvcldwN0NwRzBxYmxFQ3RYRjd2aV8w?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
